en_title: AI Usage Up, PS6 and Xbox Helix Development Still Low in Newest GDC Dev Survey
cn_title: 最新GDC开发者调查：AI使用率上升，PS6和XBOX Helix开发占比仍然较低
opus_summary: GDC调查逾2600名游戏开发者，40%受访者在工作中使用生成式AI，55%认为其对游戏有负面影响。10%正为PS6开发游戏，8%正在开发XBOX Project Helix项目。受访者中21%处于失业状态，高于上次调查的13%。

paragraphs.en: GDC Festival of Gaming organizers released the data from their 15th annual game developer survey, the State of the Game Industry report. Over 2,600 game developers anonymously responded, and the results show increased generative AI usage, not too many developers working on PlayStation 6 or Xbox Project Helix next-gen projects as of yet, an increase in the number of developers in a union, and more.
paragraphs.cn: GDC Festival of Gaming组织者发布了第15届年度游戏开发者调查《State of the Game Industry》报告的数据。超过2600名游戏开发者匿名参与了调查，结果显示生成式AI的使用率有所上升，目前从事PlayStation 6或XBOX Project Helix次世代项目的开发者还不算多，加入工会的开发者人数有所增加，等等。

paragraphs.en: "40% of game industry professionals report using generative AI tools as part of their job, up four points from the previous survey," GDC reported. "57% of AI adopters use it daily. Usage is highest among those working at mobile-only studios (70%) and those working on free-to-play games (58%). Company policy tends to vary significantly by company size, with 27% of AAA workers feeling encouraged or pressured to use generative AI, compared to only 9% of indie studio workers."
paragraphs.cn: GDC报告称：「40%的游戏行业从业者表示在工作中使用生成式AI工具，比上次调查上升了4个百分点。采用AI的人中有57%每天使用。仅开发移动游戏的工作室员工（70%）和从事免费游戏开发的人员（58%）使用率最高。公司政策往往因公司规模不同而有显著差异，27%的AAA游戏从业者感到公司鼓励或施压要求他们使用生成式AI，而独立工作室员工中这一比例仅为9%。」

paragraphs.en: However, the report continued, "despite the industry’s increased adoption of generative AI, its use remains polarizing; 55% of respondents felt that it has a negative impact on games, which is consistent with 54% from the previous survey. Responses suggest that game industry professionals are forming nuanced stances on the topic. For instance, some respondents wrote that they see value in using generative AI tools for repetitive tasks, research, and prototyping, but others cited environmental, psychological, and societal concerns for their hesitation to use such tools. Others pondered whether generative AI could be an equalizer for marginalized and excluded groups struggling with cost, geography, or access."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，报告接着指出：「尽管行业对生成式AI的采用有所增加，其使用仍然存在分歧；55%的受访者认为它对游戏有负面影响，这与上次调查的54%基本一致。回答表明，游戏行业从业者正在就这一话题形成细致而复杂的立场。例如，一些受访者写道，他们认为使用生成式AI工具处理重复性任务、开展研究和制作原型是有价值的，但另一些人表示，他们因环境、心理和社会方面的担忧而对使用此类工具犹豫不决。还有人思考，生成式AI能否帮助那些受成本、地理位置或使用机会所困的边缘化和被排斥群体获得更平等的机会。」

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, 10% of survey respondents are currently developing for PS6, with 8% currently working on Xbox's Project Helix. VR, augumented reality, or mixed reality game development is down to 3% of people surveyed, while Switch 2 development interest is up almost 10% to 47% this year.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，10%的受访者目前正在为PS6开发游戏，8%的人目前正在从事XBOX的Project Helix项目。从事VR、增强现实或混合现实游戏开发的受访者比例降至3%，而今年对Switch 2开发感兴趣的比例上升了近10%，达到47%。

paragraphs.en: Interestingly, overall support in the US for game industry worker unionization was down a tad, from 82% to 80%, but more respondents reported being part of a union – 15% this year compared to 12% last year.
paragraphs.cn: 有意思的是，美国对游戏行业员工组建工会的总体支持率略有下降，从82%降至80%，但表示自己加入了工会的受访者更多了——今年为15%，去年为12%。

paragraphs.en: Finally and unfortunately, a whopping 65% of those responding to the survey said that their mental health has suffered because of their job and the long hours – and that's for those who are still employed. A full third of respondents have been laid off in the last two years, with two-thirds of that group saying they were laid off in the past year. And sadly, more than half (54%) of those who've been laid off have yet to find another job, though not for a lack of trying: 62% say they've applied for 20 or more jobs, with over a quarter (27%) saying they've applied for over a hundred . Overall, one-fifth of survey respondents (21%) are unemployed, up from 13% in the last report.
paragraphs.cn: 最后，不幸的是，高达65%的调查受访者表示，他们的心理健康因工作及漫长的工作时间而受到损害——而这还是针对那些仍有工作的人而言。整整三分之一的受访者在过去两年中被裁员，其中三分之二的人表示自己是在过去一年被裁员的。令人遗憾的是，超过一半（54%）被裁员的人尚未找到另一份工作，但这并非因为他们没有努力：62%的人表示申请了20个或更多职位，超过四分之一（27%）的人表示申请了100多个职位。总体而言，五分之一的调查受访者（21%）处于失业状态，高于上一份报告中的13%。

paragraphs.en: The next Game Developers Conference: Festival of Gaming will take place in San Francisco on March 1–4, 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 下一届Game Developers Conference: Festival of Gaming将于2027年3月1日至4日在旧金山举行。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN负责前瞻内容的执行编辑、IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人，也是《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他来自新泽西州北部，所以他称之为「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan与他辩论这个问题。
